name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
April 24, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Vikki Ramey, President of Brother Benno’s Auxiliary
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation to Barbara Mannino, Chief Executive Officer of the Vista Community Clinic, declaring Saturday, March 24, 2012, "Joan and Ron Moss Women’s Health Center Day" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamation to Susan Hall, Angel’s Depot Founder and Director, declaring Wednesday, April 25, 2012, "The Angel’s Depot Day" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Proclamations recognizing the following individuals’ contributions to the City of Vista, by declaring:
1.
Thursday, April 26, 2012, "Destiny Landeros Day" in the City of Vista, in honor of her year as Little Miss Pride of Vista
2.
Friday, April 27, 2012, "Jordyn Kogler Day" in the City of Vista, in honor of her year as Miss Teen Pride of Vista
3.
Saturday, April 28, 2012, "Kathrine Wyatt Day" in the City of Vista, in honor of her year as Miss Pride of Vista
P4.
Proclamation declaring May 2012 "National Bike Month" and Friday, May 18, 2012, "National Bike to Work Day" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for the Month Ended February 29, 2012 (CC)
C4.
California Gang Reduction, Intervention, and Prevention (CalGRIP) Grant (CC)
C5.
Collection of Delinquent FY 2011/2012 Property Related Administrative Citations (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for the collection of delinquent property related administrative citation charges; and
2.
Set June 12, 2012, as the date of the Public Hearing to levy assessments on the 2012/2013 property tax roll for collection of delinquent property related administrative citations.
C6.
Sewer Capacity Fee Charges FY 2012/2013 (CC/BSD)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , memorializing FY 2012/2013 sewer capacity charges in accordance with City Ordinance No. 2006-6; and
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- , memorializing FY 2012/2013 sewer capacity charges in accordance with Buena Sanitation District Board Ordinance No. 2006-2.
C7.
Collection of Delinquent Mandatory Trash Charges FY 2011/2012 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for the collection of delinquent solid waste charges; and
2.
Set June 12, 2012, as the date of the Public Hearing to levy assessments on the 2012/2013 property tax roll for collection of delinquent 2011/2012 mandatory trash charges.
C8.
First Amendment to Auditing Services Agreement with Lance, Soll & Lunghard, LLP (CC)
C9.
Award of Contract for Watson Way Upsizing and Realignment - CIP No. 8070 (BSD)
1.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- , awarding a construction agreement with James W. Fowler Co. for construction of the Watson Way Upsizing and Realignment project; and
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- , amending the FY 2011/2012 Capital Improvement Program Budget.
C10.
Conflict of Interest Code for Successor Agency (CC/SA)
1.
Adopt Successor Agency Resolution No. 2012- , adopting a Conflict of Interest Code for the Oversight Board; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the Conflict of Interest Code for the Successor Agency to the Vista Redevelopment Agency.
C11.
North County Trade Tech Graduation Special Event Banner (CC)
C12.
Motorist Aid and Safety Project Grant FY 2011/2012 (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , accepting $38,610 in FY 2011/2012 Motorist Aid and Safety Program funding, and amending the FY 2011/2012 Operating Budget; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , approving the agreement with the San Diego Service Authority for Freeway Emergencies for the FY 2011/2012 Motorist Aid and Safety Project Grant Program. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
Amendment to City’s Local Bidder Preference Policy (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
